messages:
zoe: heads-up: ember7b-int4 onboard shows weird token aliasing when prompts contain emoji + soft-hyphen. Names get replaced with unrelated proper nouns in ~6% of runs.
ben: emoji + soft-hyphen? that's odd. any diffs vs fp16?
zoe: fp16 clean. int4 build used pack-8 rowwise quant and exporter applied tokenizer nfkc + emoji-folding (we recently collapse emoji variants). exporter wrote `token_merge_map` but loader ignores it.
carl: could merging change token ids and break KV cache alignment?
zoe: yes. plus rotary interleave packing changed head layout (interleaved pairs). runtime expects contiguous heads. Combined effect: embedding row shift + head-phase misalignment.
ben: can you paste quick repro and example?
zoe: repro snippet in the build log. Example: prompt with "Ana🙂" produced output mentioning "Carlos" instead of "Ana".
qa-bot: regression-alert: convo-suite named-entity-fidelity dropped 5.9% at 2024-12-11T11:02:01Z
ben: short term: disable emoji-folding in conversion for Ember nightlies and add loader that applies `token_merge_map` if present. Also coerce rotary scales to broadcast float32.
carl: agree. long-term: exporter must emit canonical_head_map and token_map; runtime must validate md5(vocab) and fail-fast if missing. I'll open a tiny loader patch and unit test.
zoe: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-runtime/pull/999 (draft) with loader remap and a test that simulates token id shift + interleaved heads.
ben: nice. QA, can you re-run the convo-suite against local patched loader?
qa-bot: queued. will report back when done.
